name: Data Act
description: EU Data Act (Regulation (EU) 2023/2854) — harmonized rules on fair access to and use of data generated by connected products and related services. Covers data sharing between businesses and with public sector, cloud-switching, and interoperability.
relationToCloudSecurity: Cloud-switching provisions (Chapter VI) directly regulate cloud providers — requirements for facilitating customer migration to other providers.
relationToAISecurity: Data sharing obligations affect AI training data sourcing from connected products.

license.notes: EU legislative texts published in the Official Journal are reusable under Commission Decision 2011/833/EU, for commercial and non-commercial purposes, with attribution to the European Union. This is deliberately not CC-BY-4.0: on EUR-Lex the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence covers editorial content, legislation summaries, and consolidated texts, while EUR-Lex metadata is CC0-1.0 and the legislative texts themselves fall under the reuse decision. Only documents published in the Official Journal are authentic.
